meta.notes: Falcon Hub Airways (fictional). History weeks 0-103 under P0. Options evaluated at request time from information available then (stock before the request, open POs/ROs at quoted due dates). exposure_aed = max(0, wait_h - deadline slack) x AOG penalty/h (archetype) + direct cost. Deadline classes are hypothetical, not MEL categories. NOTE: exposure_aed ALREADY INCLUDES direct_cost - never add them; the best option is the rank===1 option (recommended_option / decision.recommended). Infeasible options carry wait_h/exposure_aed null except pool (indicative, greyed) and acceleration (estimate).

reason_codes.LOCAL_STOCK: Serviceable unit on the shelf at the requesting station
reason_codes.NO_STOCK: No serviceable unit at the source(s)
reason_codes.COMMITTED_TO_KIT: Units on hand are committed to notified scheduled-check kits (only AOG needs may break them)
reason_codes.ROBS_KIT_RESERVATION: Feasible only by breaking a scheduled-check kit reservation (allowed for an aircraft already AOG)
reason_codes.NOT_APPLICABLE_AT_HUB: The request is at AUH itself
reason_codes.ROUTINE_SHIPMENT: Deadline slack covers routine transport; ships routine at line cost
reason_codes.BELOW_PROTECTION_LEVEL: Donor stations hold stock but only at or below their own D0 protection level
reason_codes.LATERAL_OK: Donor outstation keeps its protection level after shipping
reason_codes.NOT_CONTRACTED: No pool-exchange agreement in force (P0 history); P3 terms shown for reference
reason_codes.NO_OPEN_RO: No unit of this PN at a repair shop
reason_codes.RO_OVERDUE: Earliest RO is already past its quoted due date; remaining time assumed
reason_codes.NO_TIME_SAVED: Acceleration cannot shorten the remaining shop time
reason_codes.DOES_NOT_BEAT_ALTERNATIVES: Accelerated return is not faster than another feasible option
reason_codes.ACCELERATION_OK: Paying the shop to prioritise beats the other feasible options
reason_codes.EXPEDITE_MARKET_BUY: AOG-desk purchase at expedite lead time and premium
reason_codes.OPEN_PO_EXISTS: An order for this PN is already open (see option h)
reason_codes.NO_OPEN_SUPPLY: No open PO or RO for this PN
reason_codes.OPEN_PO_INBOUND: Earliest usable inbound unit is an open purchase order
reason_codes.INBOUND_TRANSFER: A replenishment shipment to this station is already in transit (ETA from ship time + planned transit)
reason_codes.RO_RETURN_INBOUND: Earliest usable inbound unit is a repair return
reason_codes.QUEUED_BEHIND_BACKORDERS: Earlier unfilled requests claim the first inbound units
reason_codes.SUPPLY_OVERDUE: Inbound order is past its quoted due date; remaining time assumed
reason_codes.EXCEEDS_DEADLINE: Wait is longer than the deadline slack: the aircraft is AOG for the difference
reason_codes.HUMAN_DECISION_REQUIRED: Requires engineering/quality approval — human decision; never auto-recommended
reason_codes.NO_DONOR_AIRCRAFT: No aircraft grounded or in check at this station with this PN fitted

route_labels.b_hub_transfer_delayed: Transfer from AUH once AUH stock was replenished
route_labels.h_inbound_transfer: Replenishment already in transit to the station
route_labels.unfilled: Still unfilled at end of history

counterfactual.note: Request-level AOG hours (before merging overlapping groundings per aircraft). Best option = lowest exposure among feasible options at request time (ex ante, quoted figures). Savings use the best option's ex-post outcome where history records it (transfers: fixed transport times; awaiting an open order: its actual arrival, re-planned to an expedited purchase if it was not in by its quoted date); accelerated repair, expedite and pool were not taken, so their estimate is kept. History can beat the estimate.
